issues.description: Constructor parameter order for class Meal is inconsistent across artifacts. The template implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Meal.java) declares the constructor as Meal(String[] ingredients, String name) (parameter order: ingredients, name), but the problem statement UML, the example usages in Main (both template and solution), and the solution implementation expect Meal(String name, String[] ingredients) (parameter order: name, ingredients). This mismatch will cause compilation errors for students using the provided example code and contradicts the specified class design.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template constructor signature to match the problem statement and solution: declare public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients) and assign fields accordingly (this.name = name; this.ingredients = ingredients;). Update any template code that relied on the reversed parameter order (e.g., ensure example usages in Main pass name first, then ingredients).
